items.markdown:
Launch TWO subagents in a SINGLE message so they run concurrently, using the Agent tool twice in one response. You must not run any tool yourself other than the two Agent calls.

Agent 1 prompt: "Use WebFetch to fetch https://example.com and report the page title. WebFetch may be a deferred tool — if so, first call ToolSearch with query select:WebFetch, then call WebFetch with url https://example.com and prompt \"What is the page title?\". Report just the title."

Agent 2 prompt: "Use WebFetch to fetch https://www.iana.org/domains/reserved and report the page title. WebFetch may be a deferred tool — if so, first call ToolSearch with query select:WebFetch, then call WebFetch with url https://www.iana.org/domains/reserved and prompt \"What is the page title?\". Report just the title."

Both must be foreground (run_in_background: false is not available; just launch both in one message). Then report both titles.
I'll launch both agents concurrently in one message.
